Picking teams? 🎲 Let chance decide, so nobody argues.

1. Open game.315tools.com and tap Team maker
2. Write the names, one per line
3. Choose how many teams
4. Tap Split into teams. Tap again for a new mix

Free · No sign-up · No app ✅
